rationale: The agent made several redundant and inappropriate calls. It repeatedly executed `get_files_info` on the same directory, re‑listed the same files and re‑read the same contents without new insight. Moreover it misused `run_python_file` to attempt shell commands (e.g., "ls -la", "find …"), calling it many times with the same erroneous arguments. This pattern of repeated, unnecessary calls and misuse of the tool reflects a sub‑optimal, confusing exploration strategy.
